environment.prompt: Create one production-quality illustrated environment background asset for a premium educational browser game, Coin Champ, with a playful coin carnival / miniature boardwalk arcade art direction. Landscape 3:2, approximately 1536x1024. This is ONLY environment art, absolutely NO text, letters, numbers, labels, UI, frames, buttons, logos, or watermarks. A magical miniature carnival built on warm wooden boardwalk platforms above a softly glowing turquoise sea, violet and lilac striped awnings, a beautiful gold coin-shaped archway at the upper right, little ticket booths and luminous warm lights, a charming small glossy lavender piggy-bank mascot with warm golden accents near the right edge, and a few oversized gold coin discs nestled in the foreground. Friendly, dimensional, exquisitely finished stylized 3D game illustration, sculpted soft surfaces, polished gold metal, gentle ambient occlusion and warm afternoon light. Sophisticated enough for teens but welcoming to young children. Cinematic layered depth, a saturated deep plum shadow family and turquoise water with sunlit apricot highlights. Composition for an actual responsive game menu: reserve the LEFT 55 percent and central foreground as calm low-detail dark-purple/teal space to support real HTML title and controls; put the delightful detailed carnival environment on the RIGHT 45 percent, and keep a clear sky and soft depth behind the upper center. No clusters of floating objects across the left control area. No people. Full bleed artwork, beautifully crafted collectible-game feel, not a flat vector drawing, not photoreal, no casino, no gambling machines.
